name: Yusia
source:
"...There must be a way to get out of here."

A 20-year-old woman attending college to become a police officer. She accidentally ends up at a murder scene and is wrongfully imprisoned. Though she's not very expressive and seems unfriendly, she has the strength to face the people in front of her seriously.
